description: This file defines the OcrResult class, which represents the raw OCR output including text lines, confidence scores, processing timestamp, and OCR engine details. It contains nested class TextLine that models individual OCR text lines with associated confidence scores.

classes.name: OcrResult
classes.description: Represents raw OCR text lines and confidence scores, along with metadata such as processing time and engine used.

methods.name: getProcessedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when OCR was processed.

methods.name: setProcessedAt
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when OCR was processed.

methods.name: getEngine
methods.description: Returns the name of the OCR engine used.

methods.name: setEngine
methods.description: Sets the name of the OCR engine used.

methods.name: getLines
methods.description: Returns the list of text lines identified by OCR.

methods.name: setLines
methods.description: Sets the list of text lines.

methods.name: getFullText
methods.description: Returns the concatenated full OCR text.

nested_classes.name: TextLine
nested_classes.description: Models an individual OCR text line with text content and confidence score.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text content of the OCR line.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the OCR line.

methods.name: getConfidence
methods.description: Returns the confidence score for the OCR line.

methods.name: setConfidence
methods.description: Sets the confidence score for the OCR line.

methods.name: TextLine
methods.description: Constructor for creating a TextLine object with specified text and confidence.
